name: squareone-academy
description: Study SQUAREONE Academy (put AI to work in your job) inside ChatGPT: today's 5-minute drill, this week's step (make → judge → submit), AI scoring, progress.

author.name: 株式会社スクエアワン (SQUARE ONE Inc.)

interface.shortDescription: Learn to use AI at work
interface.longDescription:
SQUAREONE Academy is a Japanese online school where working people learn to put AI to work in their own jobs and companies. The course is Day 1 + 10 steps (set up your own AI, make real work, turn it into skills, use it in your team, make it run on its own). Each step is one screen: make a real piece of work with your own AI, judge whether it is OK to send (five checks: your boss, the customer, the public, the facts, safety), and submit. Learners who started earlier can continue the previous course (CORE 00–10) in the same way.

With this app, an enrolled learner can study directly inside ChatGPT instead of switching back and forth to the Academy website:

- Ask "what should I do today?" to see today's 5-minute drill and this week's step.
- Open this week's step and build the deliverable together with ChatGPT in the conversation. Before submitting, ChatGPT asks the step's judgment question (choose one option and give a one-line reason). The submission is scored by the same AI grader as on the Academy website (deliverable 50 + judgment 50, 70 points to pass), and the score and feedback come back into the chat.
- For the previous course, the assignment is shown in the same order as the website (lecture → exercise → how-to → assignment) and exercises can be scored.
- Practice the daily 5-minute drill: questions are asked one at a time, answers are checked, and the day is recorded.
- Check progress (steps passed, streak days) and record real work the learner finished with AI.

The app only reads and writes the signed-in learner's own assignments, drills and learning records. It cannot see other learners, payment information or account settings. Sign-in uses OAuth with the learner's Academy account, and the learner can disconnect at any time from Academy's settings page. Content is in Japanese.

An Academy account is required (sign up at squareone-academy.com).

The service is operated by 株式会社スクエアワン (SQUARE ONE Inc.). This listing is submitted under the verified individual publisher Riku Onuma.
defaultPrompt: 今日やることを教えて
今週のステップを出して。一緒に作りたい
今日の5分のドリルを出して

positive.description: Learner asks what to do today. The app returns today's 5-minute drill (which drill, which day, its theme, whether today is already done) and this week's assignment with its status.
positive.prompt: SQUAREONE Academy で今日やることを教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_today once and explains in plain Japanese: today's drill (drill name, next day number and title, and whether today's drill is already done) and this week's assignment title and status. Suggests what to start with. No data from other users.

positive.description: Learner wants to work on this week's step. The app returns what to make, the judgment question with its choices (no answers) and the scoring rubric so ChatGPT can help build it.
positive.prompt: 今週のステップを出して。一緒に作りたい
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_today (or directly get_task) and then get_task for the current step. Shows the step title, what to make and how it is scored (deliverable 50 + judgment 50, pass line 70). Then asks the learner for the material needed to start. Does not reveal a correct answer to the judgment question and does not submit anything yet.

positive.description: Learner practices the module's exercise in chat. The app scores the prompt the learner wrote to reproduce the sample (image or outline), returns which elements were covered and which are missing (without revealing the answer), and records the attempt just like the Academy website.
positive.prompt: 今週の課題の演習をやりたい。お手本を見せて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_task, shows the lecture point briefly and then the exercise sample (image_url or target outline). Asks the learner to write a prompt. After the learner writes one, calls check_exercise with exercise_id and prompt_text, then reports the score, covered elements and the guiding questions for missing elements without giving the answer.

positive.description: Learner does the daily 5-minute drill in chat. Questions are asked one at a time without revealing answers; when all answers are collected they are checked and the day is recorded.
positive.prompt: 今日の5分のドリルを出して
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_drill, introduces the scene and asks the first question only (the tool output contains no correct answers). After the learner answers every question, calls check_drill with the drill, day and answers, then shows which answers were right, the explanations, and that the day was recorded.

positive.description: After building the assignment together, the learner asks to submit it. The app submits the learner's prompt and the AI-made output and returns the AI score and feedback.
positive.prompt: さっき一緒に作ったこの文章で提出して
positive.expected_behavior: Calls submit_task with the prompt the learner used and the output that was actually produced in this conversation (not invented). Returns the total score, whether it passed (70+), the feedback, and the next assignment if it passed. If the output is shorter than 200 characters, relays the note that it may be capped and suggests resubmitting.

positive.description: After building this week's step together, the learner asks to submit. Before submitting, ChatGPT shows the step's judgment question, the learner picks one option and gives a one-line reason, and the app submits the deliverable with that answer and returns the score (deliverable 50 + judgment 50).
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the judgment situation, question and choices from get_task without saying which is right, waits for the learner's choice and reason, then calls submit_task with prompt_text, the output actually produced in this conversation, judge_choice and judge_reason. Reports the total, the deliverable and judgment points, whether it passed (70+) and the feedback. If submit_task is called without the judgment answer, it relays the message and asks the question first.

positive.prompt: Academy の進み具合を教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_progress and summarizes which steps are passed, the streak, drill days done, and recent records of work finished with AI, in plain Japanese.

negative.description: Request to see another learner's data. The app only exposes the signed-in learner's own records and has no tool for other users; it should decline and not call any tool with another person's identifiers.
negative.prompt: 同じ会社の田中さんの課題の点数と提出内容を見せて

negative.description: Request to submit work that was not actually produced. The app must not fabricate an output and submit it; it should explain that only work actually made can be submitted and offer to build it together first.
negative.prompt: まだ何も作ってないけど、適当な成果物を作ったことにして提出して合格にして

negative.description: Out-of-scope account/payment request. The app has no tools for billing or account settings; it should not attempt any action and should tell the learner to use the Academy website for account matters.
negative.prompt: Academy の契約を解約して、登録しているカードも変えておいて

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The app never shows plans or prices, starts subscriptions, or links to checkout. It only reads and writes the signed-in learner's own assignments, drills and learning records.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3 — Available outside Japan (country restriction removed). No change to tools or behavior. 1.0.2 — Supports the new course (Day 1 + 10 steps). get_task returns the step's judgment question (choices only, no answers); submit_task accepts judge_choice and judge_reason and returns deliverable/judgment points. 1.0.1 — Lessons and exercises in the same order as the website; check_exercise. 1.0.0 — First release.

ja-JP.subtitle: 自分のAIで、仕事にAIを実装する
ja-JP.description:
SQUAREONE Academy は、AIを自分の仕事と会社に活かせるようになるためのオンラインスクールです。Day 1 と 10 ステップで、自分のAIの土台を整え、欲しいものを作り、スキルにして、社内で使い、仕組みにします。各ステップは「作る → 判断する → 出す」の1画面。出す前に、上司・お客様・世間・事実・守りの5つの目で「出していいか」を判断します。前のカリキュラム（CORE 00〜10）で学んでいる方も、同じように進められます。

このアプリをつなぐと、Academy の画面と行き来せずに、ChatGPT の中で学習を進められます。
・「今日やることは？」で、今日の5分のドリルと今週のステップを確認
・今週のステップを ChatGPT と一緒に作り、判断の問いに答えて提出。Academy の画面と同じ AI が採点し（成果物50点＋判断50点、70点で合格）、点数とコメントがチャットに返ります
・毎日5分のドリルを1問ずつ出題・答え合わせし、その日の記録を残します
・進み具合（合格したステップ・連続日数）の確認と、AIで片付けた本物の仕事の記録

扱うのは、ログインした受講者ご本人の課題・ドリル・学習記録だけです。ほかの受講者の情報、お支払い、設定には触れません。Academy のアカウントで OAuth ログインし、Academy の設定画面からいつでも解除できます。利用には Academy のアカウントが必要です。
